text: This report seeks the Board’s approval to increase daily regular and exhibitor parking rates by $1.00 commencing January 1, 2019. An annual review of parking rates shows that with the $1.00 increase, Exhibition Place rates will cover operating cost increases and maintain its profitability and remain competitive in the marketplace. The last parking rate increase was implemented on January 1, 2017.

The Board of Governors of Exhibition Place: 1. Approved the adjustments in parking rates at Exhibition Place as set out in Appendix B to the report (November 1, 2018) from the Chief Executive Officer, Exhibition Place effective January 1, 2019.
